# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 052

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1275–1299, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. I simplified the food and descriptive-adjective definitions, clarified the chicken, salt, and dinner meanings in Hindi, and preserved the distinction between `hard` as difficult and `hard` as effortfully.

Changed: 25 English definitions and 3 Hindi gloss/example pairs. Refreshed source fingerprints for these 25 senses in the locale status files.  
Progress: 1,300/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (14.71%); 7,537 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
